changeSet.author: workflow-test-host
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wf_test.service_effect ( id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, request_id BIGINT NOT NULL, instance_id BIGINT NOT NULL, command_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, node_key VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT NULL, quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, actor_ref NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 NOT NULL, occurred_at DATETIME2(7) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_console_effect_request FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES wf_test.sandbox_request(id) ON DELETE NO ACTION, CONSTRAINT ck_console_effect_instance CHECK(instance_id>0), CONSTRAINT uq_console_effect_command_node UNIQUE(command_id,node_key) ); CREATE INDEX ix_console_effect_instance ON wf_test.service_effect(instance_id,id);
